description: Deletes a subnet. A subnet that still has nodes or IO systems is refused with 409 subnet_not_empty (details.nodes and details.ioSystems list everything that would be disconnected or removed) unless disconnectNodes:true, which disconnects every node from it and removes the IO systems on it first; an unknown subnet is 404 not_found. Read it with tia_subnet_get first. The result carries `disconnected`, `removedIoSystems` and a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads: the subnet is gone and no node is connected to it); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed: re-read with tia_subnets and tia_device_network before anything else. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it returns the plan {nodes, ioSystems, willDisconnect, willRemoveIoSystems} WITHOUT deleting, and a dryRun of a non-empty subnet without disconnectNodes:true is the same 409 subnet_not_empty refusal as the real call. 409 subnet_inventory_mismatch means Openness counts other nodes on the subnet than the project devices show: nothing was deleted, do not retry blindly. 409 subnet_inventory_incomplete means the serve could not list the IO systems of the subnet (details.gaps): nothing was deleted, and a dryRun refuses the same way; read tia_subnet_get (inventoryGaps) and do not retry blindly. 409 subnet_delete_incomplete means a step failed midway and the project is partially changed (details list what was removed): re-read with tia_subnet_get. Maps to DELETE /subnets/{subnet}?disconnectNodes=true. M-off.

disconnectNodes.description: confirm deleting a non-empty subnet: every node is disconnected from it and every IO system on it is removed

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

subnet.description: subnet name, as listed by tia_subnets
